summary: Iter72 — Validated 3 newly-activated Phase 2 features (Driver Destination Mode UI, Taxi Pool toggle on /ride/:id, Tip jar endpoint), 9 catalog endpoints, 10 admin pages, and P0 regression endpoints. Driver Destination Mode E2E works perfectly (UI ↔ backend in sync). Taxi Pool toggle UI works but backend has a fare-restoration bug. bidding_posts catalog returns 404 (not registered in PUBLIC_CATALOGS). Tip UI on completed ride could not be UI-tested (status transitions blocked for owner) but POST /api/phase2/rides/{id}/tip endpoint shape is correct.

critical.issue: On disable (enabled=false), backend sets new_fare = ride['estimated_fare'] which is already the discounted value from previous ON toggle. Fare stays at 70% forever after first enable. Need to persist original_fare on first enable and restore from it on disable. File: /app/backend/routes/phase2.py line 392.
Returns 404 — bidding_posts is in the spec list but missing from PUBLIC_CATALOGS set in /app/backend/routes/phase2.py. Add it so the new auction/bidding feature is reachable.

minor.issue: Returns 403 for accepted (correct), but then 400 for arrived/started/completed when ride is still pending. Expected — but could not exercise tip UI without driver-flow seed.

integration_issues.issue: 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion' modal only exposes Apple/Google/Facebook/Biometric — no email+password option, so test2@example.com cannot log in via UI. Spec says email-login should be reachable via this link.

issues: Spec used testids dest-address-input / dest-lat-input / dest-lng-input but implementation uses dest-input-address / dest-input-lat / dest-input-lng. Naming inconsistent with main-agent spec — either update spec or rename testids. Functionality works.

action_items: FIX phase2.py:392 pool/enable — persist original_fare so disable restores correct amount.
ADD 'bidding_posts' to PUBLIC_CATALOGS in phase2.py so GET /api/phase2/catalogs/bidding_posts returns [].
Decide: add email-login option to the 'autre option' modal, OR document that admin/email accounts must use a different login path.
Optional: rename destination-modal inputs to match spec (dest-address-input / dest-lat-input / dest-lng-input) or update spec.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/phase2.py line 392 — stateful bug: estimated_fare is mutated in place by pool toggle, no original_fare stored. Fix by storing original_fare on first ON and using it on OFF.
PUBLIC_CATALOGS in phase2.py is missing bidding_posts despite UI/spec referencing it.
/api/phase2/driver/destination-mode endpoint is well-designed (PUT body {active, lat, lng, address, radius_km}; GET returns {active, target}). Good shape.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (driver destination-mode 100%, taxi-pool toggle UI 100%, admin spot-check 10/10 routes load 200, tip UI not exercised due to status-transition gate)

rca_of_the_issue: Pool fare bug RCA: phase2.py enable_pool reads ride['estimated_fare'] and writes new_fare = current * 0.7 on enable. On disable it writes new_fare = current (already 0.7x). Repro: POST /api/rides to get fare F, PUT /pool/enable enabled=true → fare becomes 0.7F, PUT /pool/enable enabled=false → fare stays 0.7F instead of returning to F. Mitigation: on first enable when pool_enabled is False, also write original_fare = current estimated_fare; on disable, restore estimated_fare = original_fare and clear it. bidding_posts RCA: phase2.py PUBLIC_CATALOGS frozenset omits 'bidding_posts' so /api/phase2/catalogs/bidding_posts → 404. Mitigation: add 'bidding_posts' to PUBLIC_CATALOGS.
